map.根据 AJCC 第8版口腔癌 TNM 分期标准，输入原发肿瘤(T)、区域淋巴结(: Stages oral cancer by entering primary tumor (T), regional lymph nodes (N) and distant metastasis (M) per the AJCC 8th-edition oral-cancer TNM staging standard.
map.T3 >4cm，或深层侵袭(外肌/舌外肌): T3 >4cm, or deep invasion (extrinsic muscle / tongue extrinsic muscle)
map.T4a 侵及骨/皮肤/上颌窦: T4a invades bone / skin / maxillary sinus
map.T4b 侵及咀嚼肌间隙/翼板/颅底: T4b invades masticator space / pterygoid plate / skull base
map.⚠️ 本工具基于 AJCC 第8版分期标准辅助判读，仅供临床参考。口腔癌确诊与治: This tool assists interpretation based on the AJCC 8th-edition staging standard, for clinical reference only. Oral-cancer diagnosis and treatment need multidisciplinary evaluation. Any non-healing (>2 weeks) oral ulcer / mass / erythroplakia / leukoplakia should be watched and biopsied promptly.
map.参考：AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th Editi: Reference: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th Edition (2017). Oral cancer includes lip, buccal, tongue, floor of mouth, gingiva, hard palate, retromolar area.
map.原发肿瘤 T 分期录入，结合肿瘤大小与浸润深度，工具给出 T 分级。: Enter primary-tumor T staging combining tumor size and invasion depth; the tool gives the T grade.
map.区域淋巴结评估 N 分期，提示单侧/双侧与包膜外侵犯影响。: Assess regional nodes for N staging, suggesting the impact of unilateral/bilateral and extranodal extension.
map.远处转移 M 录入后输出完整临床分期与治疗提示。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛: After entering distant metastasis M, output the complete clinical stage and treatment notes. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：T1（≤2cm，浸润≤5mm）、N0、M0\n输出：临床 I 期；若浸润深:
Input: T1 (<=2cm, invasion <=5mm), N0, M0
Output: clinical stage I; if invasion depth >5mm or N+, the stage rises significantly, needing imaging and biopsy.
map.AJCC 第 8 版有什么更新？: What is new in AJCC 8th edition?
map.更强调肿瘤浸润深度、部位（口咽 HPV 状态）与淋巴结包膜外侵犯对分期的影响；口: It emphasizes tumor invasion depth, site (oropharyngeal HPV status) and nodal extranodal extension on staging; oral cancer refines T staging by invasion depth.
map.和筛查工具(kouqiangai-tnm)区别？: What is the difference from the screening tool (kouqiangai-tnm)?
map.本工具按 AJCC 第 8 版标准做 T/N/M 组合分期，偏专业分型；筛查工具: This tool does T/N/M combined staging by AJCC 8th edition, more professional typing; the screening tool leans toward symptoms and medical-prompting; the two complement each other.
map.分期能决定治疗方案吗？: Can staging determine the treatment plan?
map.分期是治疗规划的重要依据，但最终方案需多学科（外科、放疗、肿瘤）结合病理与全身情: Staging is an important basis for treatment planning, but the final plan needs multidisciplinary (surgery, radiotherapy, oncology) combined with pathology and general condition.
map.关于「口腔癌TNM筛查器」: About the Oral Cancer TNM Screener
map.口腔癌TNM筛查器 - 根据原发肿瘤大小淋巴结转移远处转移进行口腔癌TNM分期。: Oral Cancer TNM Screener - Stages oral cancer by primary tumor size, lymph-node metastasis and distant metastasis. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
